0003599c.evidence: 19 calls to 0x37ef0 (pool 0x35a48) reading indexed params into RAM 0xffffc268-0xffffc282 (dest pools 0x35a48-0x35a88: 0x35a48=0x37ef0, 0x35a4c=0xffffc268, 0x35a50=0xffffc26c, 0x35a54=0xffffc270, ... 0x35a7c=0xffffc27f etc.); indexes 0,2,6,10,0xc,0xd,0xe,0xf,0x10,0x16,0x18,0x12,0x13,0x14,0x1a,0x1b,0x1c,0x1d,0x1e. Called from 0x349e4 (callgraph), itself called from the boot fan-out 0x1102a. Inherited ref_getDataFromE2RAM confirmed as the boot parameter-block read.

00037ef0.evidence: Cached indexed byte read: if shadow 0xffffc28e[i] == ~0xffffc38e[i] (pools 0x37f7c/0x37f80) return shadow; else busy-check 0xbed8 (pool 0x37f70), then device read 0xbdfa (pool 0x37f88) at address 0x6000000 + ((i>>1)&0xff)*0x10000 (base pool 0x37f84 = 0x6000000); even index takes the high byte (big-endian u16). Updates shadow data+complement. Under mask 0x10 (pool 0x37f6c=0x3920, tail 0x3934). Returns error flag.

00037ea4.evidence: Indexed shadow write under mask 0x10 (pools 0x37f6c=0x3920, 0x37f8c=0x3934): for len bytes, 0xffffc28e[i] = src byte and 0xffffc38e[i] = ~byte (pools 0x37f7c/0x37f80). Callers: 0x279d8, 0x27d06, 0x35a8c, 0x4b668, 0x5d9d8, 0x5e8a4 (callgraph). Inherited ref_writeToE2RAMArea_INDEX_ADDR_LEN confirmed as the RAM shadow writer (data + complement).

00035d36.evidence: 14-byte body (words 4e0b 0009 4f26 6cf6 6df6 000b 6ef6 at 0x35d36, ROM-verified; byte-exact match with 60E0FC00 0x36456): `jsr @r14; nop; lds.l @r15+,pr; mov.l @r15+,r12; mov.l @r15+,r13; rts; mov.l @r15+,r14`. Sole caller 0x35a8c loads r14 exactly once, at 0x35a94 `mov.l @(0x35b74,pc),r14` with pool 0x35b74 = 0x00037ea4 (e2ram_shadow_byte_write), and all 14 dispatch arms `bra 0x35d36`; the epilogue pops the frame 0x35a8c pushed, so this is a tail-call trampoline to 0x37ea4, not an unknown indirect call. Resolved by the thunk audit (review_thunk_audit_labels.py); inherited ref_writeToE2RAMAreaTHUNK_ was a misnomer.

Counters 0xffffc492/0xffffc494. Callers: 0x27b8e, 0x35956, 0x4b5b6, 0x5b482.

0000be5e.evidence: Send a 4-byte frame: 0xbf3a() CS up, 0xbfa0(cmd, 4), CS down. Called from 0x379e4.

0000bfa0.evidence: SCI4 byte transmit: SCI_SCR4_B 0xfffff022 |= 0x20 (TE), loop over len bytes: wait SCI_SSR4_B 0xfffff024 bit 0x80 (TDRE), write SCI_TDR4_B 0xfffff023, clear TDRE (SSR4 = b & 0x7f | 0x78); end wait bit 0x4 (TEND), SCR4 &= 0xb. Register names from symbols.tsv.

ffffc28e.evidence: E2RAM byte shadow cache: written by 0x37ea4/0x37ef0/0x37cd8, read back for cached reads (0x37ef0 compares against the complement at 0xffffc38e).

ffffc38e.evidence: Complement shadow of 0xffffc28e (0xffffc38e[i] = ~data[i]); match means cache valid, mismatch triggers a device read via 0xbdfa in 0x37ef0.
